rules: A shared interfacial plate has one physical plate ID referenced from adjacent cells
A cell slot is a position, not an independent replicate
Actual component reuse is optional supplied policy, never inferred from the paper
Repair/reassembly records predecessor version and replaced components; replacement object gets new ID
Guide and lubrication changes create changed condition signatures; remount creates new mount ID
Preparation and coupled-control epochs have separate actuator/constraint records
A retry preserves failed attempt, current physical state and safe-reset receipt
A source expected state is not an observed state
Archive or isolate each actual object at one environment-side location
replicate_definition: The episode declares independent specimens versus repeated traces; mean/SD cannot imply unknown historical n
